page.overview:
What is Deathclaws?

Deathclaws, so-named for their signature massive claws, are a species of genetically engineered reptilian creatures originating from secret experiments by the United States government to create super-soldiers capable of carrying out high-risk, search-and-destroy missions in place of humans — part of Fallout.

In the wake of the Great War and their escape into the wild, the deathclaw population exploded and evolved to become an apex predator in the North American wasteland.

The creature which came to be called the "deathclaw" was engineered from scientific experiments conducted by the United States government to develop a cheap, cost-effective replacement for human troops during heavy-duty combat operations.

The project was successful in creating a ferocious predator capable of surviving and thriving on its own in nearly any environment, and it is known that at least one deathclaw was tested in a combat scenario prior to 2077, deployed against Chinese PLA forces on an Alaskan island during the Sino-American War.

Also known as: Deathclaw, Death Claw.
